patch_description: Inspired by the recommendation to replace fixed directional fans with randomized directions, and by the prior programs' barycentric-simplex formulation and bottleneck-focused hill climbing, this implementation uses a multi-restart annealer in (u,v) simplex coordinates. Key novel elements: (1) each sweep draws ~8 fresh random directions per candidate point (isotropic Gaussian in barycentric space, then simplex-projected), letting the search slip through asymmetric gaps; (2) moves target only the points appearing in triangles near the current minimum (bottleneck points), computed vectorized via a soft-threshold mask rather than a slow Python loop over triples; (3) a geometric temperature schedule with restarts from jittered lattice seeds, keeping only the best result. Fully deterministic via fixed seeds, with a feasible static fallback.
